lines.text: David prays from the cave, crying aloud to the LORD and pouring out his complaint before Him.
Though his spirit grows faint, David says the LORD knows his way, and a spear is hidden along his path.
David says that no one attends to him on his right and no one cares for his soul.
David cries to the LORD, calling Him his judge and his portion in the land of the living.
David asks to be rescued from his pursuers and freed from prison so that he may praise the LORD's name.
